description: Permanently delete one of your YourImageShare uploads by `id` - irreversible, the file and its links stop working immediately. Get the `id` from upload_image's response right after uploading, or from list_uploads if you no longer have it. Errors (not found, already deleted, wrong owner) come back as a normal tool error.

id.description: The upload id to delete (the `id` field returned by upload_image/list_uploads).

name: delete_upload
title: Delete an upload
